Transition

Applies a transition with default properties. By default it animates opacity, transform, and box-shadow. Opacity, transform, and box-shadow are grouped together because they are GPU-accelerated and safe to animate without triggering layout reflow. Color-related properties are kept separate as they can be more expensive to animate.

<div class="c-box b-transition u-color-primary demo-transform">
	Hover me
</div>
<style>
	.demo-transform {
		transform: scale(.95);
	}

	.demo-transform:hover {
		transform: scale(1);
	}
</style>
Hover me
